prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: APPROVAL-ONLY single portrait Rakky Ride destination-search mobile page. One screen, no phone/device frame, no comparison board, no implementation.
Input image 1: actual Google Maps public road-area crop, used ONLY as a real map-background reference. Reuse/crop/scale these map pixels; do not paint invented streets or make an illustrated/placeholder map. This contains no private location marker.
Input image 2: previously approved Rakky Ride homepage, used ONLY as style reference for calm white/mint/forest-green surfaces and rounded lower sheet. Do NOT copy its large type or service illustrations. This destination page has no car/parcel/calendar illustration.
Primary request: enhance the existing destination-page pattern while keeping real Google Maps behind it: upper40% visible map, lower60% white bottom sheet with pickup/destination inputs, suggestions, pinned Find Now button. Compact utility UI with SMALL TEXT AND SMALL ICONS, never oversized.
At a375×812 logical phone scale: ALL text13–15px (maximum title15px semibold), field labels12px, input text14px, result title14px, result subtitle12px, button14px. Utility outline icons16–18px, back20px maximum. At2x render scale double these dimensions exactly; do not interpret small text as giant display headings. Controls still have44–48px touch areas, but glyphs remain small. No huge bold titles.
Top map: small white circular back control top-left with slim20px arrow. Existing fixed map-selector is a small purple pencil/pin, decorative centered in map; it identifies a map selection, not a user's claimed real position. A restrained white pill "Drag map to adjust destination" in12px near top-right. White floating recenter control at lower-right,18px crosshair outline. Preserve visible Google branding and "Map data ©2026 Google" just above the sheet; actual app will continue using its existing real Google Maps. Do not draw a route or fake nearby vehicles.
White lower sheet with24px rounded top corners, small centered silver drag handle. Padding16px and restrained spacing. Header ONLY "Plan your ride" in15px semibold charcoal. The map already has back; no second redundant back button inside sheet.
Two clean stacked rounded inputs in a subtle silver grouped area, compact56px rows, clear alignment:
First row small teal outlined pickup circle, label "From" in12px muted, value "Current location" in14px. Second row small coral destination pin, label "To", typed query "Ikeja" in14px, a slim green active outline and insertion caret; small clear-X accessory16px on right.
Place a separate small white outlined circular swap control along the right edge BETWEEN the two input rows: proper up/down arrows16px,44px touch target, visually contained, no overlapping labels/text, no huge green floating badge.
Below inputs title "Suggestions" in13px muted. THREE compact address rows, small outlined location pin16px in pale mint circle32px at left,14px primary line,12px secondary line, faint separators. Illustrative examples: "Ikeja City Mall" / "Alausa, Ikeja"; "Ikeja GRA" / "Lagos"; "Ikeja Underbridge" / "Ikeja, Lagos". These are sample search suggestions; no result is selected yet. No saved Home/Work or fabricated history, distance, price or ETA. No extra buttons or new feature tiles.
At bottom a quiet top divider then full-width48px rounded12px "Find Now" button in a MUTED DISABLED green fill with readable label. It stays disabled in this example because the user has typed a query but has not chosen a destination. No misleading enabled booking action. Comfortable bottom safe area. No giant empty gap; suggestions naturally fill the sheet.
Palette: white #FFFFFF, silver #EEF1EC, charcoal #141A14, mutedtext #586253, primary #176B17, mint #EAF5E5. Existing map colors retained. Use Inter-like typography, delicate borders, minimal shadows, no gradients, no emoji or pictographic text characters standing in for icons. Existing map, drag-sheet, search and route behavior are to be preserved if later approved. Show this one clear design with tidy professional alignment and compact mobile scale. Keyboard omitted in this approval mockup so the full layout can be reviewed. Small outside caption "Destination search • Design proposal • Sample results".

Use case: ui-mockup. Edit this destination-search proposal, preserving the compact inputs, copy, outline icons, small result rows, swap action, disabled Find Now button, colors and map reference. Two precise adjustments only:
1. Use a TALL mobile screenshot proportion approximately390×844 logical pixels (9:19.5 aspect ratio), instead of the current shorter9:16. Add the extra vertical room to the MAP, so it occupies the TOP40% of the full phone screen. Keep map roads based on the same reference, no newly imagined map. The white rounded sheet starts40% down. Move the recenter and attribution to the bottom of that visible map. Keep all sheet contents at the same compact scale rather than stretching or enlarging anything.
2. Reduce "Plan your ride" to a restrained15px semibold at390 logical width, only slightly stronger than field text. NOT a big heavy headline. Keep input text14px, result titles13–14px, secondary text12px, utility icons16–18px. Slightly reduce vertical gaps in the sheet if needed. Small, neat and compact.
No new features or new controls, no giant imagery, no phone frame. Keep disabled button because query is unselected. Keep "Destination search • Design proposal • Sample results" OUTSIDE the actual screen as a small footer. This is an approval image; actual existing Google Maps will be preserved during later implementation.
